thread:
ana: Heads up — compliance flagged a permission change on 2024-10-02 that has no user attached in the audit log. they need a full chain for SOC2. :worried:

devon: Can you paste the audit entry?

ana: (typo) ana: pasted below — note actor is null and request_id is missing: 

```
{
  \"event_type\": \"role.update\",
  \"resource\": \"role:read-only\",
  \"timestamp\": \"2024-10-02T18:12:33Z\",
  \"actor\": null,
  \"metadata\": { \"service\": \"authz-service\" }
}
```

jules: hmm. that's not our usual shaped event. we normally enrich with `initiator_principal` (user/email) from the request auth token. sounds like the enrichment step didn't run.

meera: tagging @compliance-bot so they see we're on it — i'm opening INC-2024-187 for the audit gap.

compliance-bot: Thanks @meera — please provide root cause and remediation plan within 48h.

devon: quick theory: two paths can trigger role.update: the API (user-driven) or the batch role-migration job that runs nightly as `infra-migrator` service account. if infra-migrator used short-lived creds and our enrichment lookup calls KMS to fetch signing metadata, maybe KMS call failed and we skipped adding actor. check KMS request logs.

ana: I checked the authz-service logs around that timestamp — we see a 500 when calling /token-introspect to the identity service, then we fallback and emit actor=null. stack snippet: ``error: token introspect 500 -> emit anon actor``

jules: ok that explains missing actor, but we shouldn't emit nulled entries without a correlation id. at minimum we need to add `fallback_initiator: service:infra-migrator` and `correlation_id` so compliance can trace it.

meera: remediation plan proposal: 1) patch authz-service to always include `request_id` and `auth_path` even when introspect fails; 2) backfill missing actor info by joining migration job logs (infra runs with audit log lines) and patch the audit entries where we can; 3) add alert when an audit event is emitted with actor==null.

devon: agree. backfill approach: correlate by timestamp +/- 5s, by request IP and job container id. i'll write a script to join authz-audit -> infra-migrator logs.

ana: could also check KMS logs for any key operations that align — if the migration called KMS to unwrap creds we can tie to the service account.

jules: long term: we should change the enrichment sequence so we never lose the original auth header and we include `raw_auth_token_hash` in the event for offline forensics (hash only).

meera: i'll turn the plan into a runbook and assign tasks. devon for backfill, jules for the code patch, ana for logs + KMS correlation. please update INC-2024-187 with progress.

devon: quick Q — is it safe to retroactively edit audit rows in our audit DB for compliance? we usually prefer append-only.

compliance-bot: For SOC2, annotated corrections are acceptable if we keep original row and write a linked correction row with justification. maintain immutability of raw events.

jules: perfect. patch will write correction rows, not mutate original. also adding an alert to PagerDuty when actor==null for role.* events.

ana: starting to gather logs now. will post snippets if I find matching infra-migrator request IDs. :mag:

sre-bot: deploy bot: authz-service v2.4.7 rolled out to staging with extra logging at 2024-10-03T02:10:00Z.

meera: thanks — try to promote patch to prod only after we have backfill script ready. want a clean audit trail before we change retention or redact anything.

devon: estimated ETA for backfill script: 6-8hrs. I’ll push a minimal PR for adding correlation_id to events within the hour.

ana: noted. adding a quick hack to export candidate events to a CSV for compliance while backfill runs.

jules: will open a PR for the alert and the non-destructive correction rows. linking to INC-2024-187.

meera: great work team. once we have remediation and a note for compliance, close the loop. :white_check_mark:
